# Learn Python (LP)

> LP is a free, interactive Python course. 812 lessons (tutorials + reference) with
> examples you can run in the built-in code editor, plus video courses. Lessons and
> saved videos work offline through the site's PWA service worker; AI features and
> sign-in need internet. No install required.

## Lessons
